correctness.rationale: PASS: Reconstructed the exact squared Vandermonde product from three monic z^m-a discriminants and three pairwise resultants. The phase torus is covered by half-gap delta in [0,pi/2] and mean phi; the outer-distance product is strictly convex in cos(phi) and forces phi=pi away from a strictly suboptimal boundary. For t=-cos(delta) in [-1,0], derivative of (1-t²)(A-Bt)² has exactly one interior maximizing root with -1/2<t<0 because 0<B<A. Substitution fixes the displayed radical, unique unordered optimizer and maximum. For q=(r/s)^m, t=-2q+18q³+O(q^5), the normalized optimum/equal per-orbit factor tends 4/3 and m q->0, yielding (4/3)^m(1+o(1)). Independently recomputed 4 direct complex Vandermonde determinants (m=1,2,3,4) and exact resultant product at predicted phases; agreement 1e-8 relative. Singular radii r=s excluded, equality of phases zero determinant, m=1 included.
residual_risks: Finite tests validate numerical algebra in only four m/r/s instances, not the global theorem; proof provides all quantifiers.
